steps: Knead a stiff dough from the flour, water, a spoon of oil and salt and work it fifteen minutes.
Roll the dough into a thin sheet and cut it into two-millimetre noodles.
Spread the noodles on a cloth, dust them with flour and dry them twenty minutes.
Simmer the chicken with the onion, chickpeas, cinnamon and white pepper in two litres of water for forty minutes.
Add the turnip in wedges and cook twenty minutes more, until tender.
Steam the noodles over the broth fifteen minutes, take them off, sprinkle with oil and toss them.
Repeat the steaming twice more, mound the noodles, top with the chicken and turnip and ladle broth over.
